info.title: feedfence
info.description: Audits effective NuGet package sources and Package Source Mapping against the resolved dependency graph. Detects ambiguous, unmapped, inherited, and unsafe restore-source policy.

options.name: --config
options.description:
Use this NuGet configuration instead of hierarchy discovery.
NuGet's implicit machine defaults still apply and are bounded before parsing.

options.name: --policy
options.description:
Use this feedfence.json instead of the repository default.
May intentionally select an external file or replace an invalid/ambiguous default.

options.name: --strict
options.description: Treat inherited active sources (FF005) as violations.

options.name: --format
options.description:
Select deterministic human-readable, JSON, or SARIF output.
KEELMATRIX_NO_TELEMETRY=1 disables FeedFence telemetry.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help.
Exit codes:
0  Analysis completed and no policy violations were found.
1  One or more policy violations were found.
2  Invocation, configuration, restore-artifact, or analysis failure.
